Container.Name: codey
Container.Overview: Codey: interactive Python learning, SQLite accounts, Google/GitHub sign-in and browser Python. One domain and one container port. Route codey.john.shiksha through Cloudflare Tunnel to this container on port 8765. All Python packages are bundled.

Config.Name: App port
Config.Description: Single host port for Cloudflare Tunnel. Container port stays 8765; change the host mapping if it conflicts.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database, authentication secret and backups. Directory must be writable by UID 99 / GID 100. Keep this mapping during upgrades.

Config.Name: Public app URL
Config.Description: Exact HTTPS origin used in the browser, without trailing slash. Default is configured for your Cloudflare Tunnel hostname.

Config.Name: Google client ID
Config.Description: Optional. Configure this and its secret together. Callback: PUBLIC_APP_URL/api/auth/callback/google

Config.Name: Google client secret
Config.Description: Google OAuth client secret. Leave empty if Google sign-in is unused.

Config.Name: GitHub client ID
Config.Description: Optional. Configure this and its secret together. Callback: PUBLIC_APP_URL/api/auth/callback/github

Config.Name: GitHub client secret
Config.Description: GitHub OAuth client secret. Leave empty if GitHub sign-in is unused.

Config.Name: Authentication secret override
Config.Description: Usually leave blank: a random secret is generated once in /data/auth-secret. For migration, enter the old secret (32+ characters) and keep it stable.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone; the interface displays dates in the browser timezone.
